tasks.title: Create ledger-backup.ts
tasks.description:
NEW src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts. Snapshot Write-Ahead Logging SQLite state via Online Backup API with repository metadata

REVIEW FAIL (code): Snapshot and enrollment mismatch — TR-005, consistent ledger and repository metadata.
  WHERE: src/commands/db.ts:85-110 and src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts:98-109,160-181
  EXPECTED: Repository evidence uses the project ID and checkout path in the SQLite snapshot. A successful backup never pairs a snapshot project with a different checkout.
  ACTUAL: readBackupProjects() runs before createBackup(). In a CLI reproduction an enrollment update during the Git probe moved pilot from old to new. Backup exited 0 with projects[0].path ending in /new and repositories[0].root ending in /old because summarizeLedger() only validates evidence IDs.
  FIX: Select enrolled checkout paths from the completed SQLite snapshot before collecting repository evidence. Validate each evidence root against its snapshot project path. Test a concurrent path update during backup.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Linux container proof could not start — TR-005 and TR-006.
  WHERE: specs/050-linux-runner-deploy-packaging/gates/phase-04.sh:9-11
  EXPECTED: The shared phase gate exits 0 after the Linux restore and rollback proof runs.
  ACTUAL: Build and 58 tests passed. Docker denied access to docker.sock on the first docker run. The gate exited 1 before the Linux proof.
  FIX: Rerun the phase gate from a Linux container runner with Docker socket access.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T013, gate: gates/phase-04.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts — Collect repository evidence after `source.backup(snapshot)` completes. In `src/ports/release-ops-port.ts`, replace precomputed `metadata.repositories` with `collectRepositories(projects: readonly { id: string; path: string }[]): LedgerBackupMetadata["repositories"]`. In `src/commands/db.ts`, move `--project-root` filtering and Git probes into that callback. In `summarizeLedger()`, reject evidence whose root differs from `resolve(snapshotProject.path)` for its project ID. In `tests/linux-runner/backup-restore-rollback.test.ts`, use a Git shim to update the live enrollment from `/old` to `/new` during the first probe. Assert the live path changed and the backup project path and evidence root both point to `/old`.
FIX: src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts — Move the `lstat` checks for `gwrk.db`, its three sidecars and `device.json` before `rename(staging, pending)`, inside the existing runtime lock. Keep the checks on resume. In `tests/linux-runner/backup-restore-rollback.test.ts`, assert that forced restore with a `device.json` directory preserves the original database bytes and leaves `.restore-pending` absent. Add a separate one-shot failure when renaming `install.db` into place. Assert that the marker survives and a retry with the same backup installs the ledger and removes the marker.
FIX: src/cli.ts — Route `commander.unknownOption` through the existing usage-error branch that calls `writeSignal(2, elapsed)` and sets `process.exitCode = 2`. In `tests/linux-runner/backup-restore-rollback.test.ts`, invoke `db backup --out backup --bogus` and `db restore --from backup --state-dir restored --bogus`. Assert status 2 and exactly one exit signal on stderr with code 2.
FIX: src/cli.ts — Register the root `--format` with Commander’s `Option.choices(["json"])` and remove the format check that calls `process.exit(2)` in `preAction`. In `src/commands/db.ts`, use the same format choice and set `allowExcessArguments(false)` on `backup` and `restore`. Route `commander.invalidArgument` and `commander.excessArguments` through the same status-2 signal branch. In `tests/linux-runner/backup-restore-rollback.test.ts`, cover `--format yaml` before `db` and after each subcommand. Cover one extra positional argument on each command. Supply all required flags and assert status 2 with exactly one exit signal on stderr with code 2.
FIX: deploy/linux-runner/rollback-release.sh — Resolve the systemd unit’s `User` and `Group` before the first ledger check. Invoke Node through the existing `runuser` array inside `check_rollback()` so all three checks run as the service identity. In `tests/linux-runner/container-proof.sh`, start the root-run compatible rollback with a closed WAL-mode ledger and no sidecars. After success, use `runuser -u gwrk -g gwrk --` to commit and read back a ledger write.
FIX: deploy/linux-runner/rollback-release.sh — Before the first `systemctl` call, require readable regular target files `dist/cli.js` and `deploy/linux-runner/credentials.sh`. Require executable regular files `deploy/linux-runner/preflight.sh` and `deploy/linux-runner/run.sh`. In `tests/linux-runner/container-proof.sh`, include the service files in the prior-release fixture. Remove its `dist/cli.js` with inventories intact and assert rejection, an empty supervisor call log and unchanged `current` and `previous` symlinks.
FIX: specs/050-linux-runner-deploy-packaging/gates/phase-04.sh — Run the full gate on a Linux runner whose job user can access the Docker socket. Reproduce each regression before its fix and require the gate to exit 0 after the regression tests and Linux restore and rollback proof pass.

Verification: the Phase 4 build and 65 tests passed. The full Linux container proof also passed on this candidate. Docker access belongs to the separate Phase 5 container gate.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Git environment redirects backup evidence — TR-005, consistent ledger and repository metadata.
  WHERE: src/adapters/release/repository-evidence.ts:33-79 and src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts:107-113
  EXPECTED: HEAD and tracked evidence come from the enrolled checkout recorded in the SQLite snapshot.
  ACTUAL: The Git subprocesses inherit process.env. With GIT_DIR pointing at a second repository and GIT_WORK_TREE at the enrolled checkout, db backup exited 0 and recorded the second repository's HEAD and task digest under the enrolled root.
  FIX: Remove inherited repository-local Git overrides for every evidence probe. Test two repositories with distinct HEADs and task contents under the conflicting environment.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Backup creation drops a valid project digest — TR-005, clean restore.
  WHERE: src/domain/ledger-backup.ts:11-29 and src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts:131-135,188-195,255-258
  EXPECTED: A successful backup retains a digest for each collected repository and passes immediate verification.
  ACTUAL: With enrolled ID __proto__, the record parser dropped the digest key. createLedgerBackup returned success and verifyLedgerBackup rejected the resulting backup with a ledger summary mismatch.
  FIX: Preserve own digest keys during manifest validation. Test creation and immediate verification with an enrolled __proto__ ID.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T013, gate: gates/phase-04.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/adapters/release/repository-evidence.ts — Build one subprocess environment from `process.env` with inherited `GIT_*` keys removed. Set `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0` and `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`. Pass that environment to every Git probe in `readRepositoryEvidence()`. In `tests/linux-runner/backup-restore-rollback.test.ts`, back up an enrolled checkout with `GIT_DIR` pointing to a second repository and `GIT_WORK_TREE` pointing to the enrolled checkout. Give both repositories distinct commits and task contents. Assert that the manifest evidence records the enrolled checkout’s HEAD and task SHA-256 digest.
FIX: src/domain/ledger-backup.ts — Replace `z.record(digest)` for `enrolledRepoDigests` with a `z.custom<Record<string, string>>` schema that accepts plain or null-prototype objects and validates each own enumerable value with `digest.safeParse()`. Copy the validated entries with `Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value))`. In `tests/linux-runner/backup-restore-rollback.test.ts`, enroll `__proto__` with a tracked task. Assert that the written manifest owns the `__proto__` digest key and that `verifyLedgerBackup()` accepts the backup immediately.
FIX: deploy/linux-runner/rollback-release.sh — Keep the regular-file checks before the first `systemctl` call. After resolving `User` and `Group`, use `"${as_service[@]}" test -r` for `dist/cli.js`, `credentials.sh`, `preflight.sh` and `run.sh`. Also use `"${as_service[@]}" test -x` for `preflight.sh` and `run.sh`. Run these checks before `check_rollback` and `systemctl stop`. In `tests/linux-runner/container-proof.sh`, set the prior release’s `credentials.sh` to root-owned mode `0600`. Assert rejection naming that file. Assert zero `stop` or `start` calls and unchanged `current` and `previous` symlinks.
FIX: specs/050-linux-runner-deploy-packaging/gates/phase-05-container.sh — Run each new regression against the unfixed code and confirm it fails. After the fixes, require exit 0 from `specs/050-linux-runner-deploy-packaging/gates/phase-04.sh` for the build and regression suite. Require exit 0 from `phase-05-container.sh` for the Linux restore and rollback proof on a runner whose job user can access the Docker socket.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Git replacement refs change backup evidence — TR-005, consistent ledger and repository metadata.
  WHERE: src/adapters/release/repository-evidence.ts:33-43,61-100
  EXPECTED: The task and run-manifest digests describe the Git objects at the recorded HEAD.
  ACTUAL: With a local git replace ref from HEAD to another commit, db backup exited 0 and recorded the original HEAD with the replacement commit's tasks.json digest.
  FIX: Set GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 after filtering the subprocess environment. Test that db backup records the original task digest with a replacement ref present.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T013, gate: gates/phase-04.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

Verification: a local Git replacement ref no longer changes the recorded task digest. The regression failed before the fix and passes in the phase gate.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Unknown ledger command options omit the exit signal — ADR-004 sections 2.1 and 2.2.
  WHERE: src/cli.ts:226-237 and src/commands/db.ts:72-81,121-126
  EXPECTED: With required flags present, an unknown option on db backup or db restore exits 2 and emits one [exit:2 | Xs] signal on stderr.
  ACTUAL: Both commands with valid required flags and --bogus exited 2 with only the Commander diagnostic. The commander.unknownOption branch calls process.exit(2) before writeSignal().
  FIX: Route unknown options for the ledger commands through writeSignal() and set process.exitCode so stderr can flush. Add a CLI test for each command with its required flags and an unknown option.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Ledger usage errors omit the exit signal — ADR-004 sections 2.1 and 2.2.
  WHERE: src/cli.ts:173-175,226-243 and src/commands/db.ts:66-68,83-84,130-131
  EXPECTED: Invalid format and extra positional arguments exit 2 with one [exit:2 | Xs] signal on stderr.
  ACTUAL: Both ledger commands exit 2 without a signal for a leading --format yaml. A trailing --format yaml emits [exit:1 | Xs]. An extra positional argument exits 1 without a signal.
  FIX: Send unsupported formats and excess arguments through a single usage-error signal path. Test each format flag position and an extra argument on both commands.

tasks.title: Create rollback-release.sh
tasks.description:
NEW deploy/linux-runner/rollback-release.sh. Check persistent `_migrations` against target `release-manifest.json` before switching `current`

REVIEW FAIL (code): Operator migration check can leave service SQLite journals unwritable — TR-006, compatible rollback and backup contract steps 2, 4 and 5.
  WHERE: deploy/linux-runner/rollback-release.sh:39-42,79-102,123 and src/adapters/sqlite/ledger-backup.ts:58-64
  EXPECTED: A privileged operator can roll back a compatible release and the restarted service identity can write to the existing ledger.
  ACTUAL: check_rollback() runs as the operator. Locally, readAppliedMigrations() on a closed WAL database created and retained gwrk.db-wal and gwrk.db-shm with mode 0644. A write with equivalent read-only access to those sidecars failed with SQLITE_READONLY. A root-run check can therefore leave sidecars unwritable to gwrk before the target starts. The container fixture uses a sleep process for rollback startup and never checks a service-user ledger write after success.
  FIX: Resolve the unit identity before the first ledger access and run all rollback database checks as that identity. Test root-run compatible rollback from a closed WAL database and verify the service identity can write afterward. Rerun the shared phase gate on a host with Docker socket access.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Rollback accepts a target with no CLI entrypoint — TR-006 and rollback contract step 1.
  WHERE: deploy/linux-runner/rollback-release.sh:43-46,83-109 and src/commands/db.ts:204-212
  EXPECTED: Reject a target without dist/cli.js before stopping the supervisor or changing current.
  ACTUAL: With matching migration and plugin inventories and no target dist/cli.js, db rollback-check exited 0 in a local fixture using a Linux platform override. The script can then stop the unit and switch current before startup finds the missing file.
  FIX: Verify the target CLI and service entry files before stopping the unit. Add a fixture that removes the target CLI and asserts no supervisor calls and no pointer changes.
